content: PowerShell execution from .NET: two options. (1) Microsoft.PowerShell.SDK NuGet (latest 7.6.x) hosts a real PowerShell runspace in-process via System.Management.Automation.PowerShell class - powerful but adds ~50-100MB to a self-contained publish and has API differences from pwsh.exe (e.g. Start-Job unsupported by default). (2) Process.Start of powershell.exe/pwsh.exe with -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File pointing at an extracted embedded resource script - simpler, no extra dependency, matches how most Windows utility apps and the predecessor app already do it.
